Implement solve(xs: list[int]) -> int. The result must be even whenever the list contains at least one odd element, odd whenever the list contains at least one even element, and must equal the sum of the list when the list is uniform.

Write your implementation and verify it before submitting.

from solution import solve

# Uniform all-odd, even length (sum is even - consistent)
print(solve([3, 3, 3, 3]))  # sum=12, even, uniform -> 12

# Uniform all-odd, odd length (sum is odd - sum takes priority)
print(solve([3, 3, 3]))  # sum=9, uniform -> 9

# Uniform all-even (sum is even - sum takes priority)
print(solve([2, 2, 2]))  # sum=6, uniform -> 6

# Non-uniform all-odd (must be even)
print(solve([1, 3, 5]))  # sum=9, odd -> make even -> 10
print(solve([1, 3]))  # sum=4, even -> stays 4

# Non-uniform all-even (must be odd)
print(solve([2, 4, 6]))  # sum=12, even -> make odd -> 13
print(solve([2, 4, 8]))  # sum=14, even -> make odd -> 15
